mapper.select: select p.pet_id as petId, p.pet_name as petName, p.breed as breed, p.image as image, p.age as age, p.gender as gender, p.price as price, p.description as description, p.like_count as likeCount, p.category_id as categoryId, c.category_name as categoryName, c.group_name as groupName, t.space_need as spaceNeed, t.activity_need as activityNeed, t.care_level as careLevel, t.exp_level as expLevel, t.noise_level as noiseLevel, t.kid_friendly as kidFriendly, t.monthly_cost as monthlyCost, t.traits as traits from pet_info p join pet_match_trait t on t.pet_id = p.pet_id left join pet_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id where (p.status is null or p.status = '0')
